name: MLX LM
description: Optional local text generation on Apple silicon (summaries, script drafts, structured text) through mlx-lm, as a separate capability from your coding assistant.

install.setup: uv venv --python 3.12 ~/.nexus-local/runtimes/mlx-lm && uv pip install --python ~/.nexus-local/runtimes/mlx-lm/bin/python mlx-lm==0.32.0

python.description: Python in the isolated mlx-lm environment

model.description: Default model repo (an MLX model on Hugging Face), e.g. mlx-community/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-4bit

invocation.summary: Nexus runs worker.py with the environment's Python per request: mlx_lm.load(), the tokenizer's chat template, then mlx_lm.generate(). No server stays running; the model is freed when the process exits.

io.input: A prompt (text or file), optional system prompt, token limit, sampling settings
io.output: Generated text on stdout or in a file; with --json, parsed and checked JSON

limitations: This is a separate tool you call; it does not replace the model inside Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI.
Only models already downloaded are used; download one explicitly after checking its size.
Small local models write weaker scripts than large cloud models; video jobs never depend on this integration.
Run it before or after speech generation and video rendering, not alongside them, on a 36 GB machine.
